translations.Adaptación condensada ~4:50 según docs/l: Condensed ~4:50 adaptation based on docs/light-delay-festival-cut-adaptation.md. Shots/takes pending.
translations.Cael omitido; detección/navegación absor: Cael omitted; detection/navigation absorbed by Rao/UI.
translations.Rao asume detección/comunicaciones de Ca: Rao takes over Cael's detection/communications function.
translations.Aparece brevemente en el puente y en el: Appears briefly on the bridge and at the discovery; retains authorship of the passive greeting as an asset/UI element.
translations.Proxima fue una estación científica jovi: Proxima was a Jovian science station before contact.
translations.Celestial Ardor fue construida en la Tie: Celestial Ardor was built on Earth and was already assigned to Proxima.
translations.La boca es un campo distribuido de nodos: The mouth is a distributed field of nodes, not a ring.
translations.La boca local está en una órbita halo co: The local mouth is in a controlled halo orbit near L2.
translations.La nave usa propulsión convencional hast: The ship uses conventional propulsion to reach the mouth and crosses the Velari tunnel.
translations.La estación Velari y la nave emisaria so: The Velari station and the emissary ship are separate objects.
translations.El relé físico, el mensaje óptico y el s: The physical relay, optical message, and passive greeting form complementary evidence.
translations.Sorell no queda culpabilizada por un úni: Sorell is not incriminated by a single falsifiable record.
translations.Rao contiene la rama hostil mediante ais: Rao contains the hostile branch through prepared isolation, without a magical resolution.
translations.La respuesta Velari es un reconocimiento: The Velari response is limited recognition, not established trust.
translations.Harlan corta la malla inalámbrica y el r: Harlan cuts the wireless mesh and wired backup; Zao uses the external laser through its dedicated physical control and aims at the ship's future corridor.
translations.Proxima, Celestial Ardor y primera anoma: Proxima, Celestial Ardor, and the first anomaly in the diplomatic system.
translations.Establecer espacio, misión y peligro sin: Establish setting, mission, and danger without exposition.
translations.Zao revela la firma falsa; Harlan corta: Zao reveals the forged signature; Harlan cuts wireless and COM A/B; she aims the external laser at the future corridor.
translations.Comprimir bloqueo, elección de destino y: Compress the communications block, choice of destination, and transmission without losing causality.
translations.Muerte elidida; Harlan limpia y regresa: Death elided; Harlan cleans up and returns through service while Sorell finds Zao alone.
translations.Cerrar la coartada y preservar que Sorel: Complete the alibi and preserve the fact that Sorell does not witness Harlan's route.
translations.Investigación de Rao contra reloj; detec: Rao's race-against-time investigation; detection of a human signal.
translations.Rao muestra lo que sabe del payload y lo: Rao shows what she knows about the payload and what she still lacks; she detects the signal.
translations.La señal y la doble llave: The Signal and the Double Key
translations.Doble llave causal; revocación; Harlan a: Causal double key; revocation; Harlan activates the override.
translations.Mensaje de Zao + verificación técnica id: Zao's message plus technical verification identifies Harlan.
translations.Clímax de cuarentena con saludo pasivo d: Quarantine climax with Sorell's passive greeting as an asset.
translations.Carrera física/digital; Rao aísla el pay: Physical/digital race; Rao isolates the payload; clean channel.
Transmission, contact, and ‘You made it in time.’
translations.Canal limpio, respuesta Velari y cierre: Clean channel, Velari response, and emotional closure.
translations.En microgravedad, Harlan llega al acceso: In microgravity, Harlan reaches the bridge's axial access unseen as Zao opens a channel.
translations.Capitán, hay un payload autónomo firmado: Captain, there's an autonomous payload signed by Sorell. The signature looks forged. The physical relay points to—
translations.Harlan activa el jammer, se oculta y des: Harlan activates the jammer, hides, and disconnects COM A/B at the service-cylinder distributor.
translations.Zao comprueba wireless y ambos enlaces c: Zao checks wireless and both wired links. The external laser's dedicated control remains active; she rules out Earth and Proxima and sets a sweep across the ship's future position.
If this gets through... Acheron is inside. Harlan altered the core. The surface log is false. Cross-check the routine against the physical relay. Don't shut down mediation.
translations.El envío completa el barrido cuando Harl: The transmission completes its sweep as Harlan enters through the technical branch; he sees only TRANSMITTED, not the destination.
translations.Harlan mata a Zao fuera de campo, borra: Harlan kills Zao offscreen, erases the cameras and local file, and returns through the service cylinder.
translations.Sorell llega sola por el cilindro centra: Sorell arrives alone through the central cylinder, tries to revive Zao, and cannot communicate while the jammer remains active.
translations.Harlan restaura COM A/B, vuelve al puent: Harlan restores COM A/B, returns to the bridge, and denies seeing Sorell; Voss sends him to the core with Okoye.
translations.Puedo aislarlo. No puedo revocar a quien: I can isolate it. I can't revoke whoever controls it.
translations.No voy a entregar nuestra especie a algo: I won't hand our species over to something we don't understand.
translations.Harlan corta la malla inalámbrica y COM: Harlan cuts the wireless mesh and COM A/B; Zao uses the external laser through dedicated physical control and aims at the ship's future corridor.
translations.Presentar el conjunto, descubrir el sabo: Introduce the ensemble, uncover the sabotage, and isolate the mission.
translations.Fracturar la confianza y preparar eviden: Fracture trust and prepare evidence and containment.
translations.Autenticar la advertencia y contener el: Authenticate the warning and contain the human attack.
translations.Abrir el horizonte Velari y preservar el: Open the Velari horizon and preserve the human cost.
translations.La tripulación completa aborda una Celes: The full crew boards a Celestial Ardor already stationed at Proxima. Zao, Sorell, and Rao verify the core, the physical relay, and the passive greeting.
translations.Voss fija autoridad, Cael prepara navega: Voss establishes authority, Cael prepares navigation, Wei takes communications, and Harlan shows still-plausible friction with the mission.
translations.Harlan induce a Ansel Vega a silenciar u: Harlan induces Ansel Vega to silence an apparently redundant diagnostic alert; the action opens a window without making Vega an accomplice.
translations.Zao detecta consumos repetidos que no co: Zao detects repeated power draws that do not match the core's profile and begins a discreet investigation.
translations.Zao y Rao encuentran una envoltura no de: Zao and Rao find an undeclared wrapper. Hassan confirms that the energy anomaly is physical, not merely a software artifact.
translations.El registro superficial apunta a Sorell,: The surface log points to Sorell, but Zao marks it unverified and preserves a copy to cross-check against the relay.
translations.La envoltura revela un escaneo intrusivo: The wrapper reveals an intrusive scan. Zao warns the bridge that Sorell's signature appears forged; Harlan hears ‘physical relay’ from the access, activates the jammer unseen, and cuts COM A/B at the service-cylinder distributor.
translations.Con wireless y COM A/B caídos, Zao usa e: With wireless and COM A/B down, Zao uses the external laser's dedicated wired control. She rules out Earth and Proxima, calculates an intercept with the ship's future position, and sweeps the uncertainty ellipse as Harlan approaches through service and Sorell through the central cylinder.
translations.Harlan confronta y mata a Zao fuera de c: Harlan confronts and kills Zao offscreen, cleans the compartment, and returns through service. Sorell finds the body alone, tries to revive her, and cannot communicate; Harlan restores COM A/B before returning to the bridge and constructing his alibi.
translations.Los nodos distribuidos conectan la regió: The distributed nodes connect the navigable region for a limited window. The ship crosses after critical expansion can no longer be canceled safely.
translations.Tras el cruce, Keene confirma la muerte: After the crossing, Keene confirms Zao's death and Okoye secures the compartment. The crew realizes the killer is aboard.
translations.Voss asigna tareas separadas: Rao analiz: Voss assigns separate tasks: Rao analyzes the payload, Keene examines clinical evidence, Okoye controls access, and Wei preserves communications records.
translations.El puente y la orden directa de Voss cor: The bridge and Voss's direct order corroborate Sorell's route. Her forged credential is blocked without treating her as a suspect; Harlan tries to exploit the technical uncertainty.
translations.Fluctuaciones de soporte vital y navegac: Life-support and navigation fluctuations force Cael, Vega, and Tanaka to work under pressure; Tanaka's exact function remains undefined.
translations.Rao no repara el código corrupto: cartog: Rao does not repair the corrupted code: she maps its path and prepares a limited quarantine for the moment of activation.
translations.Harlan exige apagar toda mediación; Rao: Harlan demands that all mediation be shut down; Rao explains that doing so would erase evidence and the only diplomatic channel. Voss postpones an irreversible decision.
translations.Sorell y Carvalho verifican patrones mín: Sorell and Carvalho verify minimal greeting patterns without altering the passive read-only medium, while Rao keeps language and payload separate.
translations.Wei detecta una señal humana en el corre: Wei detects a human signal in the projected corridor. Cael maintains navigation and Voss orders it preserved without assuming authenticity.
translations.La tripulación escucha fragmentos del me: The crew hears fragments of the message. The signature proves the device's origin and time, but not yet the truth of every word.
translations.Rao cruza el mensaje con el relé físico: Rao cross-checks the message against the physical relay and passive greeting. The evidence converges without depending on a single digital record.
translations.Voss revoca la credencial de Harlan. Ant: Voss revokes Harlan's credential. Before the cascade completes, Harlan uses the last physical window and runs to the core.
translations.Okoye elige ejecutar la orden de Voss ba: Okoye chooses to carry out Voss's order on incomplete evidence while security restrains Harlan without turning the scene into an armed fight.
translations.Volkov accede a controles manuales docum: Volkov accesses manual controls documented by Zao while Cael forces the bulkhead from the bridge. His definitive specialty remains open.
translations.Rao confina la rama hostil al buffer pre: Rao confines the hostile branch to the prepared buffer. Sorell supplies the passive greeting and separates language from intrusion.
translations.La tripulación envía matemática de recon: The crew sends recognition mathematics, provenance, and an approach request through a read-only conduit.
translations.La estación Velari responde con un patró: The Velari station responds with a pattern that authorizes approach without amounting to trust, alliance, or complete explanation.
translations.Una nave emisaria distinta de la estació: An emissary ship distinct from the station approaches. Human scale is subordinated to the encounter, and the immediate threat ends.
translations.El archivo de Zao queda preservado y Har: Zao's archive is preserved and Harlan remains in custody. The transmission to Earth departs, but its consequences remain offscreen.
translations.La versión corta fusiona en Cael la func: The short version merges Wei's function into Cael.
translations.Presentar misión, tripulación y primera: Present mission, crew and first anomaly.
translations.Descubrir corrupción, conflicto interno: Discover corruption, internal conflict and evidence.

translations.Unidad dramática inicial (1 beat por esc: Initial dramatic unit (1 beat per scene; refineable).
translations.Zao identifica a Harlan; él corta wirele: Zao identifies Harlan; He cuts wireless and wired backup before heading to the core.
translations.Zao calcula y transmite al futuro mientr: Zao calculates and beams into the future while Harlan and Sorell take different axial routes.
translations.Harlan mata a Zao, limpia y restaura el: Harlan kills Zao, cleans and restores the cable; Sorell finds the body before the intersection.
translations.Harlan consolida su coartada; Voss lo en: Harlan solidifies his alibi; Voss sends him with Okoye to find Sorell.
translations.Proxima fue construida para estudiar Júp: Proxima was built to study Jupiter and an anomaly that no one knew how to name. Today, the ship that was already operating from there will leave for it. The Acheron Directive requires suspending the mission: if this alignment is lost, the next comparable one could take more than a thousand years.
translations.Una puerta que sólo ellos pueden abrir n: A door that only they can open is not an invitation between equals.
translations.Esperaron hasta que pudiéramos alcanzarl: They waited until we could reach it. If they wanted to invade us, they would not need to invite us.
translations.La mitad cree que vamos a salvarlos. La: Half believe we are going to save them. The other half believe we are going to doom them.
translations.Por eso nos enviaron a hablar antes de q: That's why they sent us to speak before fear speaks for everyone. Is the core secured?
translations.Zao lo revisó tres veces. Está obsesiona: Zao checked it three times. She's obsessed with that thing.
translations.Capitán. Si queremos llegar exactos a la: Captain. If we want to arrive exactly at the opening, we have four minutes before the exit window begins to eat into our margin.
translations.¿Alguna vez no te pone nerviosa una puer: Are you ever nervous about a door we didn't build?
translations.Mirá esto. Si en algún momento la corrup: Look at this. If at any time the corruption of a protocol exceeds thirty percent, do not attempt to repair it. Isolate it. Fixing it under pressure is like cutting the wrong wire.
translations.Rao corta la malla de prueba. La consola: Rao cuts the test mesh. The main console is left without a link; The wired control of the exterior laser retains its green indicator: “LOCAL CONTROL / EXTERIOR LASER”. Zao checks it at a glance.
translations.El saludo actualizado. Dejé también una: The updated greeting. I also left a passive copy, read only. It doesn't execute anything; It just says who we are.
translations.Y vos sos la única a bordo que me hace c: And you're the only one on board who makes me trust that we're going to say the right thing.
translations.Ingeniera Zao, control pide confirmación: Engineer Zao, control asks for confirmation of the core.
I confirm when I say I confirm.
translations.Proxima parece observatorio, refinería y: Proxima looks like an observatory, refinery and shipyard at the same time: old faded latticework, newer laboratories, black radiators and two habitats that rotate in opposite directions. The CELESTIAL ARDOR—matte white hull, gold details, and service scars—waits at the docking shaft. Interior: cold industrial dock, bluish lighting. Jupiter hangs like a small, sharp ocher disk. The crew boards in line.
translations.Varias pantallas del muelle reproducen n: Several screens on the dock play news. Overlay: "EARTH SIGNAL — DELAY: 43 MIN 18 S."
translations.Miles de manifestantes frente a edificio: Thousands of protesters in front of government buildings. Signs: "DO NOT OPEN THE DOOR." "NO CONTACT WITHOUT DEFENSE." In another city, a crowd celebrates under a luminous replica of the tunnel: "LET'S RESPOND." "WE ARE NOT ALONE."
translations.PM HARLAN (40s) observa la pantalla mien: PM HARLAN (40s) watches the screen as the crew continues boarding. VOSS (50s) approaches with a tablet.
translations.Voss apaga la pantalla y continúa hacia: Voss turns off the screen and continues towards the ship.
translations.CAEL (30s, piloto) pasa junto a ellos, s: CAEL (30s, pilot) passes by them, stops.
translations.Cael continúa hacia la nave. Al pasar, c: Cael continues towards the ship. As he passes, he locks eyes with SORELL (30s, gown over uniform), who is walking up the ramp carrying a box of linguistic equipment.
translations.Corte a ZAO (40s, mono de ingeniería) fr: Cut to ZAO (40s, engineering overalls) in front of the diplomatic core, a pulsating crystal sphere. RAO (30s) is next to him with a tablet. On the adjacent technical console, a control is labeled LOCAL CONTROL / OUTDOOR LASER.
translations.Zao confirma el enlace físico del contro: Zao confirms the physical link of the control; the mesh test is still down.
translations.Sorell se detiene junto a Zao un instant: Sorell stops next to Zao for a moment, hands him a folder.
translations.Sorell sonríe, sigue camino. Un TÉCNICO: Sorell smiles and continues on her way. A TECHNICIAN approaches Zao.
translations.Trayectoria confirmada. Arco de paso por: Trajectory confirmed. Jupiter flyby arc loaded. Fifty-seven hours, forty-eight minutes to the mouth. After that, there is no turning back.
translations.Entonces que sean cincuenta y siete hora: So let it be fifty-seven hours well spent. Forward.
translations.Puente reducido, dispuesto perpendicular: Compact bridge, arranged perpendicular to the thrust axis; curved cyan-blue displays. Cael is at her station. Voss sits in the command chair.
translations.PG exterior La nave se desprende del mue: External PG The ship detaches from the axial spring. Now free of Proxima, it deploys dark veils of thermal radiation and directs its magnetic nozzle toward the exit arc. Overlay: "TRANSIT TO THE MOUTH: 57H 48MIN."
translations.Tres veces en tres horas. Eso no es ruid: Three times in three hours. That's not noise, it's a pattern.
translations.¿Quién entra al núcleo a esta hora...?: Who enters the core at this time...?
translations.Overlay: \"T+29H — ARCO DE PASO POR JÚPI: Overlay: "T+29H — JUPITER PASSAGE ARC / INVERSION." Away from the planetary disk, the radiators retract. An alarm orders securing positions; the thrust falls and everything is in free fall. The ship rotates one hundred and eighty degrees, redeploys the radiators, and resumes 1 g to brake. Zao remains restrained while checking a panel.
translations.Toca la lectura. Se expande: un gráfico: Play the reading. Expands: an energy graph with an anomalous, recurring spike.
translations.Abre el registro de mantenimiento. Una e: Open the maintenance log. One entry stands out: access after hours.
translations.Esto no es protocolo estándar. Es un env: This is not standard protocol. It is a dormant wrapper.
translations.No puedo saber qué hace hasta que se des: I can't know what it does until it deploys. But it shouldn't be there.
translations.Zao compara la firma superficial con el: Zao compares the surface signature with the block's behavior, but does not open a channel yet: she needs to confirm whether the wrapper can execute autonomously.
translations.Copia el estado para Rao y deja el regis: Copy the status for Rao and leave Sorell's record marked UNVERIFIED.
translations.Overlay: \"T+40H.\" Zao conecta su table: Overlay: "T+40H." Zao plugs her tablet into a port. Lines of code. She finds a marked, altered block.
translations.Profundiza. El código se traduce en un p: Go deeper. The code results in an incomplete visual pattern: a structure that may be an aggressive verification system or a routine of unknown compatibility.
translations.Cruza el registro superficial de accesos: Cross the surface access log. A name appears: "SORELL — ACCESS LEVEL 3."
translations.Zao mantiene la investigación local; no: Zao keeps the investigation local; she does not alert the bridge until she has physical proof.
translations.Zao mira otra vez el nombre de Sorell. M: Zao looks at Sorell's name again. Mark the surface record as UNVERIFIED.
translations.Overlay: \"GARGANTA: PRECARGA / PROPULSI: Overlay: "THROAT: PRELOAD / PROPULSION: ZERO." In microgravity, the envelope is deployed as INTRUSIVE SCANNING/AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION. Zao crosses the surface register against the physical relay.
translations.En pantalla, la firma superficial de SOR: On the screen, SORELL's surface signature remains next to the physical override relay. The layers do not match.
translations.Desde las consolas del puente, Voss qued: From the bridge consoles, Voss is in the foreground; Behind, the crew holds their positions and Sorell listens. In the background, Harlan emerges from the central cylinder and stands outside the threshold without anyone seeing him.
translations.Capitán, hay un payload autónomo firmado: Captain, there is a self-contained payload signed by Sorell.
translations.La firma parece falsa. El relé físico ap: The signature looks forged. The physical relay points to—
translations.Harlan oye “relé físico” y activa discre: Harlan hears “physical relay” and discreetly activates the jammer from his wrist. Zao's voice cuts off abruptly on the bridge.
translations.La interfaz de Zao muestra “MALLA INALÁM: Zao's interface displays “WIRELESS MESH — NO LINK” and “MESSAGE QUEUED.” The precision of the outage turns her frustration into alarm.
translations.Harlan se retira del acceso al puente, e: Harlan backs away from the bridge access, enters the service cylinder's side recess, and opens the wired distribution board. He releases the lock and pulls “DIPLOMATIC SYSTEMS — COM A/B.” Both carriers go dark.
translations.Sorell, vaya al núcleo. Averigüe qué fal: Sorell, go to the core. Find out what they forged and what Zao found.
translations.Espere. No vaya sola. Busque a Harlan y: Wait. Don't go alone. Find Harlan and go in together.
translations.Sorell libera sus correas y sale por el: Sorell releases her restraints and exits through the vestibule. Harlan is already propelling himself through the service cylinder with the coupler secured to his suit.
translations.Zao abre el intercomunicador de pared. “: Zao opens the wall intercom. “COM A — NO CARRIER”. Try the backup: “COM B — NO CARRIER.” That the mesh and the two physical links fail at the same time confirms a deliberate intervention.
translations.La consola local del láser exterior cons: The external laser's local console retains power and control through its dedicated conduit. Zao moves to it without explaining her conclusion.
translations.La solución Tierra queda en rojo: recepc: The Earth solution remains in red: post-match reception. Proxima does not offer usable optical acquisition.
translations.Zao superpone el plan de vuelo, el tiemp: Zao overlays the flight plan, light timing, and future position of Celestial Ardor. The pre-match interception window becomes available.
translations.La huella divergente del láser cubre par: The divergent laser footprint covers part of the uncertainty ellipse. Zao adjusts a narrow scan over only the remaining region.
translations.Harlan se lanza por un tramo libre del c: Harlan launches himself along a free section of the service cylinder, corrects between peripheral trays and brakes at the gate of the technical branch.
translations.Sorell busca el puesto de Harlan, no lo: Sorell looks for Harlan's position, does not find it and advances alone through the central cylinder, hand over hand between breaks and gates.
translations.Zao graba mirando al sensor; el paquete: Zao records looking at the sensor; the packet will repeat throughout the sweep.
If this gets through... Acheron is inside. Harlan altered the core. The surface log is false. Cross-check the routine against the physical relay. Don't shut down mediation. Please...
translations.Presiona TRANSMITIR. La portadora recorr: Press TRANSMIT. The carrier sweeps: 40%… 70%… 100%. TRANSMITTED.
translations.Harlan entra por el ramal técnico cuando: Harlan enters through the service branch after the targeting solution has closed. He sees the completed transmission, not its destination.
translations.¿A quién le escribís, Zao?: Who are you sending that to, Zao?
You didn't have to find this.
translations.Y vos no tenías que hacerlo. Todavía pod: And you didn't have to do it. You can still—
translations.Ya no hay “todavía”. Y no vas a decirme: There is no “yet” anymore. And you're not going to tell me where you pointed.
translations.Zao y Harlan se sostienen la mirada en m: Zao and Harlan look at each other in microgravity.
CUT TO BLACK. Brief struggle. Silence.
translations.Harlan asegura temporalmente el cuerpo,: Harlan temporarily secures the body, wipes his access trail, the camera records, and the local file, then cleans every surface he touched. He keeps the jammer active.
translations.Harlan abandona el núcleo por el ramal t: Harlan leaves the core through the technical branch and propels himself back through the service cylinder.
translations.Sorell entra por el acceso operativo y e: Sorell enters through the operational access and finds Zao. She anchors herself, steadies the body, and checks for breath and pulse.
translations.Sorell fija a Zao contra una superficie: Sorell pins Zao against a restraining surface and attempts to resuscitate her, unintentionally altering the scene.
translations.Puente, emergencia en el núcleo. Zao no: Bridge, emergency in the core. Zao doesn't respond. Do you receive me?
translations.El jammer bloquea el comunicador de Sore: The jammer blocks Sorell's communicator. In the wall intercom, COM A and COM B are still without carrier. The voice is not queued.
translations.En el distribuidor junto a mando, Harlan: At the distributor next to the control, Harlan reinserts the COM A/B coupler, confirms both carriers, cleans the dash and closes the panel.
translations.Harlan reaparece en el vestíbulo y se su: Harlan reappears in the vestibule and straps into his bridge station as if returning from his duties. Anxious, Sorell remains beside Zao and does not call again.
translations.Los nodos negros separados por kilómetro: Black nodes separated by kilometers connect. The navigable region reaches 150–200 m; Celestial Ardor drifts with the engine off and radiators retracted.
translations.La nave atraviesa por inercia. Distorsió: The ship passes through by inertia. Total distortion, silence and throat collapse behind her.
translations.El puente continúa en microgravedad. Los: The bridge remains in microgravity. The radiators begin to deploy before the next burn; Harlan is visibly strapped into his station.
translations.Okoye, vaya con Harlan. Búsquenla en el: Okoye, go with Harlan. Look for her at Zao's station.
translations.Harlan y Okoye salen por el vestíbulo. F: Harlan and Okoye exit through the hallway. Out of sight of the bridge, Harlan deactivates the jammer.
translations.Harlan conduce a Okoye por el cilindro c: Harlan leads Okoye through the center cylinder and operational access, concealing the service route he used earlier.
translations.Encuentran a Sorell junto a Zao. Okoye a: They find Sorell next to Zao. Okoye secures the compound and requests Keene; Harlan depicts seeing the scene for the first time.
translations.Usted oyó el aviso y llegó por orden mía: You heard the warning and came on my orders. The signature used belongs to your credential; that does not make you a suspect.
translations.Zao alcanzó a decir que parecía falsa. M: Zao managed to say it looked forged. My greeting is on passive media; it cannot execute anything.
translations.Entonces bloquee esa credencial hasta sa: Then lock that credential until you know what they copied.
translations.Bloqueada. Sorell permanece en la invest: Locked. Sorell remains in the investigation.
translations.El saludo limpio está en soporte de sólo: The clean greeting is on read-only media. Zao verified it.
